: Euclid (n + k)) 2, ((∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → μ₀ (ball w ε) ≠ 0) ↔ z + r • w ∈ T.support)) ∧ (∀ μ ∈ 𝓜, ∀ K : Set (Euclid (n + k)), IsCompact K → μ K ≠ ∞) ∧ (∀ μ ∈ 𝓜, μ = (μHE[n] : Measure (Euclid (n + (ENNReal.ofReal (lam⁻¹ ^ n) • μ.map (dilation y lam)) = dilation y lam '' D μ) ∧ (∀ μ ∈ 𝓜, ∀ y : Euclid (n + k), ‖y‖ < 1 → ∀ lams : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ j, 0 < lams j) → StrictAnti lams → Tendsto lams atTop (𝓝
